timeline.value: CFTC designates KalshiEX LLC as a contract market
timeline.detail: Release 8302-20. Kalshi event contracts are treated by the CFTC as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act.
Section 71119 creates the Medicaid community engagement requirement; section 71107 creates six-month redeterminations; section 71112 shortens retroactive coverage.

timeline.value: CMS issues its implementation bulletin and slide deck
timeline.detail: The Information Bulletin for states plus the summary deck that defines applicable individuals, the qualifying activities, and the exclusions.
County policy for the work and community engagement requirements and for six-month renewals for the New Adult Group. Both are labelled preliminary guidance.

timeline.value: 2026 Federal Poverty Level guidelines take effect
timeline.detail: Published January 15, 2026 at 91 FR 1797. $15,960 for one person; $22,025 at 138% FPL.

timeline.value: Asset limits return for non-MAGI Medi-Cal; adult immigrant enrollment freeze takes effect
timeline.detail: $130,000 for one person plus $65,000 per additional person. Adults 19+ without a qualifying immigration status can no longer newly enroll in full-scope Medi-Cal.

timeline.value: DHCS issues ACWDL 26-07 on retroactive coverage
timeline.detail: From January 1, 2027: 1 month of retroactive coverage for the MAGI New Adult Group, 2 months for all other groups.

timeline.value: CMS issues the interim final rule (CMS-2454-IFC)
timeline.detail: Published in the Federal Register June 3, 2026. States must generally implement no later than January 1, 2027.

timeline.value: Covered California announces 2027 rates and plans
timeline.detail: $300 million for the California Premium Subsidy, reaching up to 200% FPL; more than 500,000 projected to receive it.

timeline.value: DHCS mails the member outreach letter (MEDIL I 26-25)
timeline.detail: "Dear Medi-Cal Member" letters dated August 31, 2026, issued September 11, 2026. Mailed to New Adult Group members from late August 2026.
Signed by the Governor September 14, 2026; filed and chaptered September 15, 2026. It is the California implementation of the federal work rule.

timeline.value: Counties must include the work-rule outreach letter in every application packet
timeline.detail: MEDIL I 26-25 outreach requirement for new and returning members.

timeline.value: Federal reclassification of certain immigration statuses
timeline.detail: Affected people get state-funded full-scope Medi-Cal until June 30, 2027.

timeline.value: Covered California open enrollment for 2027 coverage
timeline.detail: Current members can renew or switch from October 1, 2026.

timeline.value: Work and community engagement requirements begin; six-month renewals begin; FFS transition; shorter retroactive coverage
timeline.detail: All four take effect on the same date. Applications dated on or before December 31, 2026 are not assessed for the work rule until the member's next renewal in 2027.

timeline.value: Asset limits drop to $21,000 / $31,000; dental reductions and monthly premiums for some members
timeline.detail: Affected groups: people who are undocumented, some green card holders in the five-year bar, and PRUCOL residents.

timeline.value: DHCS deadline to adopt regulations for Welfare and Institutions Code § 14005.69
timeline.detail: WIC § 14005.69(o)(2). The section remains operative only while the federal provision is operative.
